gaps.explanation: 'Neither of + plural noun + singular verb' (formal English).

gaps.sentence: He ran so fast that we lost ___ of him.
gaps.explanation: 'lose sight of somebody' = no longer see them.

gaps.sentence: This time tomorrow we ___ flying to Rome.
gaps.explanation: Future continuous: will be + -ing for an action in progress at a future time.

gaps.sentence: She ___ the door quietly behind her.
The garden is ___ than I expected — it's huge!
We had the walls ___ last month.
gaps.explanation: 'have something done' = arrange for it to be done: had the walls painted.

gaps.sentence: I couldn't ___ laughing at his accent.
